items.title: MSC.532(107) and A.1207(34) — decomposed (Stage 4 package), stale status and mischaracterization corrected
items.sourceAvailability: Done: both official IMO PDFs downloaded and read in full. MSC.532(107) (11 pages) decomposed to 13 nodes across the 4 SOLAS chapters it actually amends (II-1, II-2, V, XIV) — its meta.json previously described only the II-1/3-13 lifting-appliances regulation, undercounting three other substantive amendment groups, now corrected. A.1207(34) (233 pages) decomposed to 12 nodes at General-section/Annex level (5 General sections + Annexes 1-5 + Appendix 1); its 5 certificate-survey Annexes are not yet broken out to individual certificate/survey-type level. Remaining: A.1207(34) Annex-level deepening; MSC.532(107) already at regulation level, no further decomposition needed for its 4 amended chapters.
items.notes: Completed as a Stage 4 package — see releases/2026-07-22-package-msc-assembly-resolutions.md. Also fixed a genuine editorial defect flagged by amendment-tracker.js: msc-532-107's edition status was stuck at "future-effective" after its 1 January 2026 entry-into-force date had already passed (as of 2026-07-21/22) — corrected to "current", clearing the stale-status-flags count to 0. Selected over irs-ssr-parts-2-3 because it combined higher relationship leverage (completing existing SOLAS-side edges) with a documented accuracy defect (both the stale status and the metadata undercounting), consistent with "repository quality has priority over repository size."

items.title: MEPC.328(76) — decomposed to chapter/regulation level (Stage 4 package), mischaracterization corrected
items.sourceAvailability: Done: full 86-page official IMO PDF (downloaded from wwwcdn.imo.org) read chapter-by-chapter; all 5 chapters / 31 regulations authored with real page citations. meta.json corrected — title/summary/keywords/tags/citations/provenance/applicability had previously mischaracterized this resolution around its minor UNSP-barge-exemption clause (Reg. 3.4/8.4) instead of its primary EEXI/CII/SEEMP content; now corrected and cross-checked against pre-existing MARPOL-VI-13/14/23/26/28 nodes for consistency. Remaining: paragraph-level depth for the longer regulations (Reg. 13 NOx, Reg. 24/25 EEDI/EEXI tables), and Chapter 5/Appendix I (IAPP Certificate form) is intentionally not planned for node-level decomposition (pure form, not substantive regulation).
items.notes: Completed as a Stage 4 package — see releases/2026-07-22-package-mepc-328-76.md. Selected over msc-532-107 and irs-ssr-parts-2-3 because it carried a documented content-accuracy defect (mischaracterization), not just a coverage gap or a metadata staleness issue — directly serving 'repository quality has priority over repository size.' Added regulation-level amends relationships from Reg. 13/23/25/26/28 to the pre-existing MARPOL-VI-13/23/26/28 nodes (previously zero relationships), and a third major-conversion.json instrument entry sourced from this resolution's own Reg. 2.2.17 definition.

items.title: IRS Steel Ship Rules Parts 2 (Inspection & Testing of Materials) and 3 (General Hull Structural Requirements) — decomposed to full chapter level (Stage 4 package)
items.sourceAvailability: Done: same local PDF already used for Parts 1/4/5 (IRS class main_rules_july_2024-edition.pdf, 2840 pages) — Part 2 (11 chapters) and Part 3 (17 chapters, 2 volumes) fully mapped from their real tables of contents and all chapters authored with real page citations verified against actual chapter-start pages (not just TOC page references). Both parts went from a single 1-chapter stub (4 nodes each) to full chapter-level coverage (11 and 17 chapters respectively, 71 nodes total for the whole standard, up from 45). Remaining: section/paragraph-level depth within the newly-added chapters (only the pre-existing Ch.11 Welding Consumables and Ch.16 Welding chapters have section-level children).
items.estimatedEffort: L (remaining section-level depth pass across 26 chapters)
items.notes: Completed as a Stage 4 package — see releases/2026-07-22-package-irs-ssr-parts-2-3.md. Selected as the sole high-priority expansion-manager item this session — no tie to break. The coverage-report.js depth heuristic already read this standard at 80% before this package (Parts 1/4/5 were already 3+ levels deep), so this package's real contribution — 26 new chapters across 2 previously single-chapter-stub parts — does not move that percentage; it is measured in node count and breadth instead, a known limitation of the depth-only heuristic (see coverage-report.js's own header comment). Added one relatedTo relationship (Part 3 Ch.4 Stability -> SOLAS-II1) where a genuine, verifiable cross-standard connection existed; no originatingInstrument/documentFamily applicable since IRS is a classification society issuing its own rules directly, not adopting them via an external resolution.
